M4.L1.title: Identify and draw points, lines, line segments, rays, and angles. Recognize them in various contexts and familiar figures.

M4.L2.title: Use right angles to determine whether angles are equal to, greater than, or less than right angles. Draw right, obtuse, and acute angles.

M4.L3.title: Identify, define, and draw perpendicular lines.

M4.L4.title: Identify, define, and draw parallel lines.

M4.L5.title: Use a circular protractor to understand a 1-degree angle as 1 protractor.

M4.L6.title: Use varied protractors to distinguish angle measure from length measurement.

M4.L7.title: Measure and draw angles. Sketch given angle measures, and verify with a protractor.

M4.L8.title: Identify and measure angles as turns and recognize them in various contexts.

M4.L10.title: Use the addition of adjacent angle measures to solve problems using a letter for the unknown angle measure.

M4.L11.title: Use the addition of adjacent angle measures to solve problems using a letter for the unknown angle measure.

M4.L12.title: Recognize lines of symmetry for given two-dimensional figures. Identify line-symmetric figures, and draw lines of symmetry.

M4.L13.title: Analyze and classify triangles based on angle measure.

M4.L14.title: Define and construct triangles from given criteria.

M4.L15.title: Classify quadrilaterals based on parallel and perpendicular lines and the presence or absence of angles of a specified size.

M4.L16.title: Reason about attributes to construct quadrilaterals on square or triangular grid paper.
